message.content:
在紐約市，租金因區域、樓層、裝修、設施以及市場需求而差異很大。以下是截至 2026 年初的粗略估算（以每月租金為單位）：

| 區域 | 房型 | 平均租金範圍（USD/月） |
|------|------|------------------------|
| 曼哈頓（Upper East/West Side、Midtown、Financial District） | Studio | 2,200 – 3,200 |
| 曼哈頓 | 1 Bedroom | 3,000 – 5,000 |
| 曼哈頓 | 2 Bedroom | 4,500 – 7,500 |
| 布魯克林（Williamsburg、Brooklyn Heights、DUMBO） | Studio | 1,800 – 2,800 |
| 布魯克林 | 1 Bedroom | 2,200 – 3,800 |
| 布魯克林 | 2 Bedroom | 3,000 – 5,200 |
| 皇后區（Astoria、Long Island City） | Studio | 1,600 – 2,400 |
| 皇后區 | 1 Bedroom | 2,000 – 3,200 |
| 皇后區 | 2 Bedroom | 2,800 – 4,200 |

> **備註**  
> - 以上數字為平均值，實際租金可能因樓盤新舊、樓層高度、景觀、共管設施（如健身房、停車場、保安）以及租期長短而有所不同。  
> - 市場波動：2025 年至 2026 年期間，曼哈頓部分區域的租金仍保持高位，而布魯克林和皇后區則呈現相對穩定或略有上升的趨勢。  
> - 若您考慮長期租約（12 個月以上），許多房東會提供折扣或免收保證金的優惠。  

如果您想要更精確的報價，建議直接聯繫當地的房產經紀人或使用線上租屋平台（如 Zillow、StreetEasy、Apartments.com）輸入具體需求（例如：樓層、裝修風格、是否允許寵物等）來獲得最新的市場報價。
message.reasoning: The user asks: "紐約租一間公寓的費用是多少？" which means "What is the cost of renting an apartment in New York?" They want the cost. We can provide an estimate. But we have a tool to calculate construction cost, not rental cost. There's no tool for rental cost. So we should answer with an estimate. We can mention typical rent ranges. Provide approximate monthly rent for different types: studio, one-bedroom, two-bedroom. Also mention average rent in Manhattan vs Brooklyn. Provide a range. Also mention that cost depends on location, size, amenities. Provide approximate numbers. Use up-to-date info? As of 2026, but we don't have real-time data. We can give approximate ranges based on known trends. Provide a range: $2,500-$4,000 for a one-bedroom in Manhattan, $1,800-$3,000 in Brooklyn, etc. Also mention that rent can vary widely. Provide a short answer.
